_readme: Data structure for the items in the Renzo Renzi virtual exhibition.
Confirmed fields (title, creator, type, metadata standard, rights) are taken from the project document.
Fields still to be filled in are marked with null or empty arrays and a _todo comment.
See ARCHITECTURE-NOTES.md for schema decisions and open questions for the team.

items.title: Il primo Fellini
items.creator: Renzo Renzi
items.holdingInstitution: Biblioteca Renzo Renzi, Cineteca di Bologna
items.metadataRationale: Published monograph best described with bibliographic metadata; MODS allows detailed description while being flexible for digital collections
items.rightsNote: Cappelli closed down — copyright status to be verified
items._todo_images: path in img/items/il-primo-fellini/ once the object photos are uploaded
items._todo_texts: min. 3 texts on the length/competence/tone grid (Claudia)
items._todo_map: waiting on the choice of museum floor plan
